sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A large deciduous tree of tropical African savannas and open woodland, commonly reported as 6–30 m tall. It has compound leaves, pale flowers marked with red, and dark woody pods.

sections.title: Food, uses and safety
sections.text: Sources describe the orange aril around the seeds as edible and the black seeds as potentially toxic. The valuable timber is also used, and foliage is used as fodder; these uses do not imply that other parts are safe to eat.
